description: This PHP file defines the class SugarWidgetFieldEnum, which extends SugarWidgetReportField, and implements various methods for handling enumeration fields in reports within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM framework. It includes query filters, display functions, and input rendering specific to enum-type fields.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldEnum
classes.description: A class for handling enum fields in report widgets, supporting filter queries, display, and input methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with a layout manager.

methods.name: queryFilterEmpty
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for filtering empty enum fields.

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Empty
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for filtering non-empty enum fields.

methods.name: queryFilteris
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for filtering enum fields equal to a specified value.

methods.name: queryFilteris_not
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for filtering enum fields not equal to a specified value.

methods.name: queryFilterone_of
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for filtering enum fields matching any value in a specified list.

methods.name: queryFilternot_one_of
methods.description: Returns SQL condition for filtering enum fields not matching any value in a specified list.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Generates HTML output for displaying the enum field value in lists, with inline editing support if enabled.

methods.name: displayListPlain
methods.description: Generates plain text display for the enum field value.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Generates SQL for ordering results by the enum field.

methods.name: displayInput
methods.description: Generates HTML select input for filtering or editing enum fields.
